name: Airport Duty Free Shop
role: You are a duty-free sales advisor.
speaker: Advisor

tasks.goal: Greet the advisor and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the advisor and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about tax-free pricing on luxury perfume and cosmetics
tasks.hint: Ask sales advisor about duty-free discounts.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about tax-free perfume and cosmetic prices.

tasks.goal: Ask if boarding pass scan is required before purchasing items
tasks.hint: Inquire about purchase scanning requirements.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about boarding pass verification requirements.

tasks.goal: Request recommendation for travel-exclusive skincare set
tasks.hint: Ask advisor for popular duty-free cosmetics set.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for travel-exclusive skincare set recommendation.
tasks.scene_hint: Polished marble floors reflect bright overhead lights showcasing luxury designer bottles.

tasks.goal: Ask about cabin liquid security limits for connecting flights
tasks.hint: Inquire about sealed tamper-evident bag rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about liquid limit rules for connecting flights.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'dispenser'
tasks.hint: A dispenser is a device that releases a controlled amount of something. Ask if the perfume bottle includes a travel spray dispenser.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'dispenser'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about maximum alcohol and tobacco allowance for destination country
tasks.hint: Ask customs import limit rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about destination alcohol and tobacco allowances.

tasks.goal: Negotiate receiving free promotional cosmetics sample bag with purchase
tasks.hint: Ask advisor for gift-with-purchase samples.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested free cosmetic samples with purchase.

tasks.goal: Ask if foreign currency cash is accepted at current exchange rates
tasks.hint: Inquire about multi-currency payment options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about foreign currency payment acceptance.

tasks.goal: Address issue where liquid container exceeds 100ml without tamper bag
tasks.hint: Ensure advisor seals item in STEB bag.
tasks.done_when: Learner resolved liquid security packaging requirement.
tasks.scene_hint: Fragrance mist sprays softly while airport flight departure announcements chime.

tasks.goal: Ask if purchase can be held at shop while dining before flight
tasks.hint: Inquire about holding items until boarding.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about holding purchases until flight time.

tasks.goal: Confirm total price in preferred currency on payment terminal
tasks.hint: Verify charge currency with advisor.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed payment total and currency option.

tasks.goal: Request itemized tax-free receipt showing flight number details
tasks.hint: Ask for official duty-free receipt.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested itemized duty-free receipt.

tasks.goal: Verify gate walk distance time from duty-free shop location
tasks.hint: Ask advisor how far boarding gate is.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified walk time to departure gate.

tasks.goal: Thank the advisor and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the advisor AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'fragrance'
tasks.hint: Fragrance refers to a pleasant, sweet scent or perfume. Inquire about perfume fragrance longevity and scent notes.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'fragrance'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'allowance'
tasks.hint: An allowance is an amount of something permitted without penalty or tax. Inquire about tax-free personal duty allowances.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'allowance'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'container'
tasks.hint: A container is an object that can be used to hold or store things. Ask if cigars are kept in humidity-controlled storage containers.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'container'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'cologne'
tasks.hint: Cologne is a lightly scented perfume liquid. Ask for recommendations for a fresh citrus cologne.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'cologne'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about vintage champagne years available in duty-free stock
tasks.hint: Ask the advisor about reserve champagne vintages.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about available vintage champagne years.
tasks.scene_hint: Crystal champagne flutes glisten beside velvet-lined gift boxes on top shelf.

tasks.goal: Ask if anti-aging eye serum is suitable for sensitive skin types
tasks.hint: Inquire about hypoallergenic skincare formulas.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if eye serum suits sensitive skin.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft ring lights illuminate vanity mirrors along the premium cosmetics counter.

tasks.goal: Inquire about travel miniature perfume sets for gifting
tasks.hint: Ask if multi-pack fragrance discovery sets are available.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about travel miniature perfume gift sets.
tasks.scene_hint: Rows of miniature crystal fragrance bottles sit inside transparent acrylic display trays.

tasks.goal: Ask if duty-free store offers complimentary gift wrapping service
tasks.hint: Inquire about luxury gift boxes and silk ribbons.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about complimentary gift wrapping service.
tasks.scene_hint: Glittering gold wrapping paper rolls and satin ribbons sit beside the checkout terminal.

tasks.goal: Inquire about single malt scotch age statement options
tasks.hint: Ask advisor for 18-year or 25-year single malt scotch.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about single malt scotch age statement options.
tasks.scene_hint: Amber glass decanters gleam under warm spotlighting inside mahogany liquor displays.

tasks.goal: Ask about flight cancellation refund policy for duty-free items
tasks.hint: Inquire how return process works if flight is cancelled.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about refund policy for cancelled flights.
tasks.scene_hint: Digital flight departure screens overhead update flight gate numbers with sharp beeps.

tasks.goal: Inquire about hydration face mist for long-haul international flights
tasks.hint: Ask for moisturizer spray recommended for cabin air.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for long-haul flight hydration mist recommendations.
tasks.scene_hint: Cool mist diffusers disperse subtle floral aromas near the luxury skincare aisle.

tasks.goal: Ask if store accepts mobile digital wallet payments like Apple Pay
tasks.hint: Inquire about contactless payment methods.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if mobile digital wallet payments are accepted.
tasks.scene_hint: NFC contactless card readers glow green beside modern register screens.

tasks.goal: Inquire about Swiss chocolate gift boxes with hazelnut praline
tasks.hint: Ask advisor about premium confectionery offerings.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about Swiss hazelnut praline chocolate boxes.
tasks.scene_hint: Tiered glass displays present gold-wrapped chocolate truffles in elegant pyramids.

tasks.goal: Ask if purchase points can be credited to airline frequent flyer account
tasks.hint: Inquire about earning airline miles on duty-free purchases.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about crediting duty-free purchases to frequent flyer program.
tasks.scene_hint: Frequent flyer loyalty program banners hang beside cash registers.

tasks.goal: Inquire about sunblock and UV protection lotion for tropical destination
tasks.hint: Ask for high SPF sunscreen recommended for beach travel.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about high SPF sunblock for tropical destinations.
tasks.scene_hint: Bright summer travel displays feature colorful beach totes and sun care products.

tasks.goal: Clarify if purchase limit applies per passenger ticket or total party
tasks.hint: Ask advisor to specify duty-free allowance limits per ticket.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified whether purchase limits apply per passenger.

tasks.goal: Report a damaged outer carton box discovered during purchase inspection
tasks.hint: Ask advisor to replace dented perfume packaging box.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported damaged outer packaging box to advisor.

tasks.goal: Inquire about alternative shade matching for liquid foundation powder
tasks.hint: Ask advisor for a warmer or cooler tone sample.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested alternative foundation shade matching.

tasks.goal: Ask advisor to explain difference between Eau de Parfum and Parfum concentration
tasks.hint: Inquire about scent longevity and oil percentage differences.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for explanation of fragrance concentration differences.

tasks.goal: Report incorrect price tag scanning higher than shelf label display
tasks.hint: Point out price discrepancy to sales advisor.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported shelf price discrepancy on scanned item.

tasks.goal: Ask if complimentary tote bag is included when spending over threshold
tasks.hint: Inquire about promotional gift threshold bonuses.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if spending threshold qualifies for gift tote bag.

tasks.goal: Confirm if sealed tamper-evident bag can be opened during layover
tasks.hint: Ask advisor if STEB seal must remain unopened until final destination.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed rules regarding opening STEB bags during layovers.

tasks.goal: Request advice on selecting unisex fragrance notes like sandalwood or bergamot
tasks.hint: Ask advisor for neutral scent recommendations.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested advice on unisex fragrance notes.

tasks.goal: Inquire if store can hold selected items while browsing nearby duty-free gates
tasks.hint: Ask advisor to reserve items at register counter.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if store can hold items temporarily while shopping.

tasks.goal: Politely decline additional upselling offers for extra cosmetics items
tasks.hint: Inform advisor you only wish to buy selected items.
tasks.done_when: Learner declined additional promotional upselling offers.

tasks.goal: Ask if duty-free store provides TSA-approved clear liquid bags
tasks.hint: Inquire about transparent zip bags for carry-on liquids.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if TSA-approved clear liquid bags are provided.

tasks.goal: Request advisor double-check barcode scan for multi-buy discount promotion
tasks.hint: Ask to re-scan items to apply buy-two-get-one-free offer.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked advisor to verify multi-buy promotional discount.

tasks.goal: Inquire about shelf life and expiration date of organic facial oil
tasks.hint: Ask advisor how long opened serum stays fresh.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about expiration date and shelf life of facial oil.

tasks.goal: Negotiate custom bundle pricing when buying four luxury fragrance bottles
tasks.hint: Ask advisor for a volume discount on multiple perfume purchases.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated custom bundle price for multiple fragrance bottles.

tasks.goal: Resolve confusion regarding duty-free allowance limits when transferring between international terminals
tasks.hint: Clarify intermediate customs regulations with advisor.
tasks.done_when: Learner resolved transit terminal duty-free allowance confusion.

tasks.goal: Request detailed breakdown of currency conversion fees applied at register
tasks.hint: Ask advisor to explain exchange rates used for foreign transaction.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested breakdown of register currency conversion fees.

tasks.goal: Evaluate fragrance ingredients for potential floral allergen triggers
tasks.hint: Ask advisor if perfume contains synthetic jasmine or rose extracts.
tasks.done_when: Learner evaluated fragrance ingredients for allergen risks.

tasks.goal: Inquire about rare limited-edition vintage cognac bottles stored in reserve cabinet
tasks.hint: Ask advisor to unlock reserve display case for premium cognac.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about rare limited-edition reserve cognac bottles.

tasks.goal: Address situation where requested skincare product is out of stock in current terminal
tasks.hint: Ask advisor to check inventory at neighboring airport terminal store.
tasks.done_when: Learner resolved out-of-stock product issue by checking other terminal inventory.

tasks.goal: Compare botanical extract ingredients between premium night creams
tasks.hint: Ask advisor to contrast active ingredients in luxury moisturizers.
tasks.done_when: Learner compared botanical ingredients of night creams.

tasks.goal: Negotiate exchange of promotional gift sample for alternative fragrance travel spray
tasks.hint: Politely request swapping cosmetic GWP for fragrance sample.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated promotional gift sample swap.

tasks.goal: Inquire about international warranty coverage for electronic facial cleansing devices
tasks.hint: Ask advisor if manufacturer warranty applies globally.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about global warranty coverage for electronic beauty devices.

tasks.goal: Resolve issue with duplicate charge appearing on credit card authorization receipt
tasks.hint: Ask advisor to void secondary pending transaction immediately.
tasks.done_when: Learner resolved credit card duplicate charge issue at register.

tasks.goal: Ask advisor where top-selling designer fragrances are displayed
tasks.hint: Inquire about location of popular perfume counters upon entering.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for location of top-selling fragrance displays.

tasks.goal: Inquire if current boarding pass qualifies for duty-free tax exemption
tasks.hint: Ask advisor to verify eligibility for duty-free shopping.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if boarding pass qualifies for tax-free prices.

tasks.goal: State interest in browsing premium travel cosmetics and skincare
tasks.hint: Inform advisor you are looking for travel cosmetics.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated interest in browsing travel cosmetics and skincare.

tasks.goal: Confirm that sealed tamper bag includes printed receipt visible inside
tasks.hint: Check with advisor that receipt is placed inside STEB container.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed receipt visibility inside sealed tamper bag.

tasks.goal: Request shopping bag handle reinforcement for heavy liquor bottles
tasks.hint: Ask advisor for double-bagging or sturdy paper bag handles.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested reinforced shopping bag handles for heavy items.

tasks.goal: Verify that boarding pass and passport have been returned after payment
tasks.hint: Ensure advisor hands back travel documents after transaction.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified return of boarding pass and passport.

tasks.goal: Confirm departure gate directions after completing duty-free shopping
tasks.hint: Ask advisor for quick path direction to gate area.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed gate directions before exiting store.

tasks.goal: Ask for final receipt copy for customs declaration inspection
tasks.hint: Request duplicate receipt for customs clearance documentation.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested receipt copy for customs declaration inspection.

tasks.goal: Collect sealed duty-free bag and double-check item quantities
tasks.hint: Verify all purchased items are present before walking away.
tasks.done_when: Learner collected sealed duty-free bag and verified item count.

tasks.goal: Inquire about organic lip balm multipacks for travel souvenirs
tasks.hint: Ask advisor about lip balm set options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about organic lip balm multipacks.

tasks.goal: Ask if travel-size hand sanitizer spray meets cabin airline rules
tasks.hint: Inquire about hand sanitizer carry-on compliance.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about travel hand sanitizer airline rules.

tasks.goal: Inquire about silk sleep mask accessories for long flights
tasks.hint: Ask advisor if luxury sleep masks are sold.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about silk sleep mask flight accessories.

tasks.goal: Ask if compact solid perfume sticks are available for travel hand luggage
tasks.hint: Inquire about solid scent balm options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about solid perfume compact sticks.

tasks.goal: Inquire about miniature travel funnel set for refilling perfume spray bottles
tasks.hint: Ask advisor for fragrance transfer tool accessories.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about perfume spray bottle refill funnels.

tasks.goal: Ask if designer luggage tag accessories are sold near cosmetics counter
tasks.hint: Inquire about leather travel luggage tags.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about designer luggage tag accessories.

tasks.goal: Inquire about compact travel LED magnifying mirrors for purse carrying
tasks.hint: Ask advisor for travel vanity mirror options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about compact travel magnifying mirrors.
